subject: LaTeX in sliderInput pre and post arguments

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: LaTeX in sliderInput pre and post arguments
parts: For the 'pre' and 'post' arguments to sliderInput it works to use withMathJax but every time you move the slider it renders again which is very ugly because it shows the actual string passed to withMathJax briefly. Is there a better way use LaTeX in the pre and post arguments? Thanks.
